dimension_b_drift.title: Call WF-47 Unsubscribe node passes `$json.userStatus` which is never set by Normalize Keyword — runtime expression evaluates to undefined/empty on the STOP path
dimension_b_drift.evidence: docs/pseudocode/WF-20.md (node: 'Call WF-47 Unsubscribe', workflowInputs): `"userStatus":"={{ $json.userStatus }}"`. Normalize Keyword node (same .md) only assigns: keyword, phoneNumber, userId, messageText. No `userStatus` assignment exists. sub-12.md WF-20 edit plan adds no userStatus carry-forward ('userStatus carry-forward NOT added (TD-DRIFT-006 deferred)'). The STOP keyword path will relay an empty userStatus to WF-47 at runtime.
dimension_b_drift.recommended_action: This is a pre-existing bug (TD-DRIFT-006), not introduced by this sprint. However, the pseudo (Step 5) now documents 'Call WF-47 with phoneNumber, userId, userStatus' which is inconsistent with actual runtime behaviour. Two options: (a) accept as known TD-DRIFT-006 and downgrade to Major if WF-47 handles null/empty userStatus safely, or (b) treat as Blocker since the .md node expression `$json.userStatus` will silently pass undefined to WF-47. Recommend verifying WF-47's handling of empty userStatus before shipping, and updating pseudo Step 5 to omit userStatus to match reality.

questions_for_human: TD-DRIFT-006: The Normalize Keyword node intentionally does NOT carry forward userStatus to the WF-47 call (per sub-12.md). The Call WF-47 Unsubscribe node in the .md still passes `$json.userStatus` which will be undefined/empty at runtime. Is WF-47 defensive against a null/missing userStatus input?
